data.projectSynopsis: A static HTML/CSS/JS form validation web application that validates username, email, password, and password confirmation fields client-side. It checks required fields, min/max length, email regex, and password matching, displaying error messages under specific inputs.

const form = document.getElementById('form'); const username = document.getElementById('username'); const email = document.getElementById('email'); const password = [REDACTED]; const password2 = document.getElementById('password2'); // Show input error message function showError(input, message) { const formControl = input.parentElement; formControl.className = 'form-control error'; const small = formControl.querySelector('small'); small.innerText = message; } // Show success outline function showSuccess(input) { const formControl = input.parentElement; formControl.className = 'form-control success'; } // Check email is valid function checkEmail(input) { const re = /^(([^<>()\[\]\\.,;:\s@"]+(\.[^<>()\[\]\\.,;:\s@"]+)*)|(".+"))@((\[[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\])|(([a-zA-Z\-0-9]+\.)+[a-zA-Z]{2,}))$/; if (re.test(input.value.trim())) { showSuccess(input); } else { showError(input, 'Email is not valid'); } } // Check required fields function checkRequired(inputArr) { let isRequired = false; inputArr.forEach(function(input) { if (input.value.trim() === '') { showError(input, `${getFieldName(input)} is required`); isRequired = true; } else { showSuccess(input); } }); return isRequired; } // Check input length function checkLength(input, min, max) { if (input.value.length < min) { showError( input, `${getFieldName(input)} must be at least ${min} characters` ); } else if (input.value.length > max) { showError( input, `${getFieldName(input)} must be less than ${max} characters` ); } else { showSuccess(input); } } // Check passwords match function checkPasswordsMatch(input1, input2) { if (input1.value !== input2.value) { showError(input2, 'Passwords do not match'); } } // Get fieldname function getFieldName(input) { return input.id.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + input.id.slice(1); } // Event listeners form.addEventListener('submit', function(e) { e.preventDefault(); if(checkRequired([username, email, password, password2])){ checkLength(username, 3, 15); checkLength(password, 6, 25); checkEmail(email); checkPasswordsMatch(password, password2); } });

criticReview.reason: The action of pressing Enter in the Username field was executed (step 2), and the expected behavior based on project documentation is that validation should check required fields, length constraints, email regex, and password matching. The evidence shows that after pressing Enter, error messages appeared for Email, Password, and Confirm Password fields, which contradicts the expected behavior of showing validation only for the field being interacted with (Username) or no validation until form submission. The observed outcome shows over-validation triggered for all fields after pressing Enter in Username field, which may indicate incorrect trigger logic.
